metadata.name: Dustwater
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: A Wild West town on one dusty main street in red-rock country (Style Pack 02: Frontier Dust): the saloon with swinging doors, the bank and its vault (blow the dynamite by the door, or work the combination), the jail, the store, the hotel and the gunsmith, the chapel with its graveyard, the barber, the livery and the gallows. A stagecoach, wagons and troughs break up the street; fences, wagons and rocks cover the back streets. The train comes through past the station all match (it runs you over; ride the flatbed), and up the bluff a mine cart trundles out of the tunnel. Revolvers at each end of town, dynamite to throw, crates that go up, plank barricades to blast through.

do.text: BOOM! The vault door is blown open!
The tumblers turn... the vault opens in ten seconds.
